name: Mikoko
source:
Takeru lives a peaceful life with various attractive girls. For your information, they are all miko. But one day, his life suddenly changes. A mysterious creature and a girl with black hair appears in front of him and says, "You'll need to choose a next Miko God and live with her as a partner!" "Miko God? Choose someone? Can I really do that?" When he is at a loss what to say, the girls around him give the answer to him, "Choose a girl you like the best." Well, a new love story starts now...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
武与许多魅力十足的女孩过着平静的生活。顺带一提，她们全都是巫女。然而某天，他的人生突然发生变化。一只神秘生物与一名黑发少女出现在他面前，说道：“你必须选出下一任巫女神，并以伴侣身份与她共同生活！”“巫女神？要我选一个人？我真的做得到吗？”就在武不知该说什么时，身边的女孩们替他给出了答案：“选择你最喜欢的女孩。”那么，一段新的爱情故事就此开始……

[摘自ErogeShop]
